title: there be 句型
unitTitle: Module 3 My school 我的学校

questions.question: 「我们班有 30 名学生。」的英文是（　）
options: There are thirty students in our class.
There is thirty students in our class.
There are thirty student in our class.
There have thirty students in our class.
questions.answer: There are thirty students in our class.

questions.question: there be 句型表示「某处有某物」。

knowledge.core_concept: there is + 单数/不可数，there are + 复数；否定 there isn't / aren't。
knowledge.key_formula: There are thirty students in our class.
common_mistakes: there is 后接复数名词。
knowledge.tips: 看后面的名词定单复数。
